questions: Do you have a sore throat or symptoms of a recent upper-respiratory infection (runny nose, cough, fever) ?
Where exactly are the swollen/painful lymph nodes located (neck/cervical, armpit/axillary, groin/inguinal, or other)?
Have you noticed any fever, night sweats, or unexplained weight loss recently?
Have you noticed any recent dental pain, swollen gums, or mouth sores?
How long have the neck lymph node pain/swelling been present, and are the nodes enlarging or staying the same?
How large are the neck lymph nodes (in centimeters), and are they firm, fixed to the skin/deeper tissues, or mobile under the fingers?
Are the neck lymph nodes about what size (e.g., <1 cm, 1–2 cm, >2 cm), and are they hard/fixed or soft/mobile?
Have you noticed any sore throat, mouth ulcers, or painful swallowing just starting around the same time as the neck node swelling?
Are the swollen neck nodes on one side or both sides of your neck?
Have you noticed any new skin rash or recent tick bite in the past month?
answers: No—I don’t have a sore throat, runny nose, cough, or fever that I know of. My symptoms are more like swollen/painful lymph nodes with crampy stomach/epigastric pain and general discomfort.
They feel mainly in my neck area—more like cervical lymph nodes. I don’t notice swelling in my armpits or groin.
No, I haven’t noticed any fever, night sweats, or unexplained weight loss recently.
No, I don’t have dental pain, swollen gums, or mouth sores.
It started recently—pain onset feels pretty quick (about 2/10 in speed). They are still tender and feel swollen, but I’m not sure if they’re getting bigger versus staying about the same.
I don’t know the exact size in centimeters. They feel tender and swollen, but I can’t tell if they’re firm or mobile, or if they’re fixed deeper versus moving under my fingers.
I’d guess they’re about 1–2 cm, but I’m not certain. They feel tender/swollen; I can’t say if they’re hard/fixed or soft/mobile.
No, I haven’t noticed sore throat, mouth ulcers, or painful swallowing starting around the same time.
I think it’s on both sides of my neck, not just one.
No rash that I’ve noticed, and I don’t remember any tick bite in the past month.
